# Redfin

> > Redfin is a technology-powered real estate brokerage offering home search, rental listings, mortgage services, and agent connections across the United States.

Redfin combines real estate services with technology platforms available on iOS and Android, partnering with services like Rocket Mortgage and RentSpree to provide comprehensive home buying, selling, and rental solutions. The platform serves major markets including California cities like San Jose.

## Key Topics

- Real estate search and listings
- Home buying and selling
- Rental properties and apartments
- Mortgage services and financing
- Real estate agents and brokers
- Property search technology
- Affordable housing and cheap apartments
- Mobile apps (iOS and Android)
- Rocket Mortgage partnership
- RentSpree integration
- California real estate markets
- San Jose property listings
- Budget-friendly rentals
- Virtual home tours

## Core Services

- [Redfin | Real Estate & Homes for Sale, Rentals, Mortgages & Agents](https://www.redfin.com): Homepage for Redfin real estate search: homes, rentals, mortgages & agents

## Rental Properties

- [Cheap Apartments For Rent Near Me - Redfin](https://www.redfin.com/cheap-apartments-for-rent-near-me): Search tool for affordable apartment rentals with photos and tour requests
